texts.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
texts.en:
Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.

These baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion.

texts.zh:
即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。

这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。。

虽然事实上就是他们错了，但是解释只会让局势变得进一步复杂。
texts.en:
Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.

These baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion..

While technically they're not wrong, explaining the matter would only complicate things further.

label.zh: 将他们最偏激的怀疑论者带到太空。
label.en: Bring their most influential skeptics to space.

label.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]才不是中空的！给他们看计算结果！
label.en: [non_believers_planet.GetName] is not hollow! Show them the calculations!

label.zh: 承认我们就是地底入侵者。

texts.zh:
结果[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不相信太空，或者说：他们认为天空是一块镶嵌着镜子的穹顶，群星是太阳光束折射到镜子上形成的，其他天体同理。

哪怕我们将他们带到了我们的首都，他们可能也会宣称自己从未离开过母星，或者其他同样离谱的事情。
texts.en:
Turns out the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't believe in space, either: they think the sky is a glass dome filled with mirrors: stars are rays of sunlight reflected from the mirrors, as are the other celestial bodies.

Even if we were to bring them to our capital, they would probably claim they had never left their home planet, or something equally absurd.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

texts.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来纷乱的新闻：尽管[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再认为我们是来自他们[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地底中心的访客，他们现在坚信自己的星球是平的，像我们这样的人是住在吊篮一样的城市里，位于[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地壳下面。
texts.en: Mixed news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: while the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't think we are visitors from the center of their [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon] anymore, they are now convinced their world is flat, and people like us live on hanging cities beneath [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s crust.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]出于我们的诚实向我们表达感谢。当然他们尚未完全相信我们，因为他们认为我们是来自中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的入侵者，但是至少他们理解我们没有敌意，希望他们能同我们开展合作。
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] thank us for our honesty. Of course they can't fully trust us yet, since they still believe we are invaders from the Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], but at least they understand we wish them no harm and are looking forward to collaborating with us.

label.en: There must be a way to sway them...

texts.zh: 在下定决心认为我们是中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的秘密住民之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始担忧[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的地表之下到底还藏着什么东西。军队开始在洞穴、喷泉和火山口的附近驻扎，随时准备用武力对抗任何从地下涌现出来的入侵者。
texts.en: After having determined we are the secret inhabitants of Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started worrying about what else may be lurking under the surface of [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. Military forces have been stationed near caves, faults and volcanoes, poised to meet any further underground invaders with force.

label.zh: 一起玩呗。给他们提供军事支援。
label.en: Play along. Offer them military support.

texts.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来难以置信的消息：真的有人藏在地表之下。属于某个先前未知物种的地下军队从洞穴里面涌现了出来，他们正在进攻[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是一场全面的入侵！
texts.en: Incredible news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: someone really was hiding under the surface! Subterranean armies of a previously unknown species are pouring out of caves, and they're attacking the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's a full-scale invasion!

texts.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，正在摧毁一切，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]绝望地寻求帮助。
texts.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating, and the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are desperate for help.

texts.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，摧毁了这个区域的基础设施。然而，幸亏我们的军队就出现在事发点附近，大多数受灾群众都被安全地撤离。
texts.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating to the region's infrastructure. However, thanks to our military presence near the scene, most of the affected population was evacuated safely.

label.zh: 至少他们现在信任我们了。
label.en: At least they trust us now.

texts.zh: 地底入侵防御部队的士兵驻扎在最大的洞穴和火山口旁边，他们报告称完全没有任何东西从地表下面冒出来。或许这是最好的情况，但是其中一些士兵明显十分失望。
texts.en: The Subterranean Invasion Defense Force troops stationed near the biggest caves and volcanoes report that absolutely nothing has emerged from beneath the surface. It's probably for the best, although some of the soldiers look visibly disappointed.

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望向我们表达感谢，以及正式的道歉。他们现在明白我们，事实上，并不是地底穴居人，而是来自另一个地方，那里是：
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would like to offer us their thanks, as well as an official apology. They now understand we are not, in fact, subterranean dwellers, but we come from another place entirely:

texts.zh: 大海。
texts.en: the ocean.

texts.zh: 他们星辰的正中央。
texts.en: the center of their star.

texts.zh: 他们对于宇宙奥妙的掌握还是不够完美，但至少他们准备相信我们了。
texts.en: Their grasp of cosmology is still less than perfect, but at least now they are ready to trust us.

label.zh: 从社会学角度来看，很有趣；从精神上来看，真是精疲力竭的体验。
label.en: A sociologically interesting but mentally exhausting experience.

texts.zh: 在经历了一场残酷的世界大战之后，[non_believers_country.GetName]被住在[non_believers_planet.GetName]地表下面的穴居物种彻底消灭。新近成为主导的物种注意到了我们的存在，出于某种混乱的好运，他们显然没有认为我们是来自他们行星的中心。
texts.en: After a vicious world war, the [non_believers_country.GetName] has been annihilated by the subterranean race living under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface. The newly dominant species is aware of our presence, and in something of a mixed blessing, obviously does not believe we come from the center of their planet.

label.zh: 终于，新邻居能够讲道理了。

texts.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
texts.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

texts.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，我们的联合部队战胜了地底入侵者，将他们赶回了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
texts.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, our combined forces triumphed over the subterranean invaders, forcing them back under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

texts.zh:
今天，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上传来了令人意想不到的消息，一张熟悉的面容向我们问好：那是一张我们自己的脸。

最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市里已经成了一等一的抢手货。
texts.en:
Unexpected news from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as a familiar face greets us: our own.

Recently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. In fact, they say that we are 'Cute.' Already, stuffed toys with exaggerated [Species.GetEarNamePlural] have become a wide-spread commodity in their cities.

label.zh: 但是——嗯——我们不——没有人曾经……
label.en: But- um- a- we are not- no one has ever...

label.zh: 我们……我们能拥有一个吗？
对任何使用我们形象的东西都要征收版税。
label.en: We will impose royalties on any use of our likeness.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上正在发生有趣的社会变革。

由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真相（包括非格式塔物种的存在），他们必定会降低对我们的信任。
texts.en:
Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

Given they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: connected. One. Without another frame of reference, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to allow our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] access to their institutions. Their misunderstanding could enable us to advance their civilization considerably. However, if the truth about the wider galaxy (and the existence of non-gestalt species) were to become known, they might become less trusting of us.

label.zh: 告诉他们我们自己还不确定。
label.en: Tell them we aren't sure ourselves.

title.en: Teach a Hive How to Craft

texts.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]。我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
texts.en: Our scientists left [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today in a shaken state. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive applications of these principles, and started waging war against a neighboring hive before we had even left their atmosphere. Now, millions of drones are dying.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]进行的任务取得了成功。我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
texts.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] were successful with their task on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive applications of these principles, and started waging war against a neighboring hive before we had even left their atmosphere. Now, millions of drones are dying.

label.en: That is the nature of progress.

texts.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
texts.en:
In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these passionate youngsters now comprise a vibrant and growing subculture on the planet.

We've even been told that an upcoming fan convention will feature a costume contest.

label.zh: 够了，我们的文化只属于我们。
label.en: Enough of this. Our culture is our own.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]大会取得了令人振奋的成功！人们不分老幼都聚集在这颗星球上最大的城市，欢庆[owner.GetName]的一切事物。除了大会带来的好意以外，它还为当地经济提供了急需的推动力。

最精彩的也许是扮装比赛，大奖颁发给了我们[owner.GetRulerTitle][owner.GetRulerName]的死忠粉丝。
texts.en:
The [owner.GetAdj] convention on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been a rousing success! Young and old alike gathered in the planet's largest city to celebrate all things [owner.GetName]. Apart from the good will the convention generated, it also provided a much needed boost to the local economy.

Best of all perhaps was the costume contest, in which the grand prize was awarded to a particularly devoted fan of our own [owner.GetRulerTitle] [owner.GetRulerName].

texts.zh: 在我们利用影响力遏制了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上蓬勃发展的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝群之后，那里的人们都团结起来以传统方式表达自己的文化。因此，艺术和文化部门的产出有了明显的改善。
texts.en: After we used our influence to curtail the burgeoning [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the people there have rallied around traditional expressions of their own culture. Accordingly, output in the arts and culture sectors has markedly improved.

texts.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝采取的强硬态度引起了巨大的反弹。这颗星球上的许多人开始推崇自己的文化和传统，激烈反对[owner.GetAdj]。

这将如何影响两颗星球的外交关系，还有待观察
texts.en:
Our hardline approach to the [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has precipitated a significant backlash. Rallying around their own culture and traditions, many on the planet have grown virulently anti-[owner.GetAdj].

How this may impact diplomatic relations between our worlds remains to be seen

label.zh: 我们不需要他们的喜爱。

texts.zh:
根据我们同[freeport_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的贸易协议，我们在他们的主要定居点附近建造了一个小型太空港。我们的商人不受规定约束，能够赚取巨额利润，但是禁止离开那片特区。

结果是，走私贩和有组织的帮派建立了一个繁荣的黑市经济。到目前为止，[freeport_species.GetAdj]选择睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是如果任由其发展，这个自由港将不可避免地被犯罪给拖垮。
texts.en:
Per our trade agreement with the [freeport_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural], we have established a small spaceport near one of their major settlements. Free from regulation, our merchants are reaping massive profits, but are forbidden of leaving the complex.

As a result, smugglers and organized gangs have established a thriving black market economy. So far, the [freeport_species.GetAdj] have turned a blind eye, but if things continue, the freeport will inevitably be overrun by criminals.

label.zh: 要求开放额外的自由港。
我们什么事情都没做错。
对走私贩出硬招，出狠招。

texts.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
texts.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

texts.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通矿物香料，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的调味品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
texts.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary mineral-based spice. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

label.zh: 禁止贸易，设置一道封锁线。
label.en: Forbid trade and set up a blockade.

label.zh: 我们必须提供医疗援助！
人命由天。但生意就是生意。
label.en: People die everyday. Business is business.

texts.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
texts.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure the sovereignty of the locals, but some of our own people are skirting the law to buy up vast quantities of land through local strawmen. At the current rate, within a generation [landgrab_planet.GetName] will be wholly owned by private traders.

label.zh: 撤回这些交易，对罪犯进行罚款。
label.en: Revoke the sales and fine the culprits.

label.zh: 一个发财致富的好机会……

texts.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
texts.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulation, but overall the deal has proven beneficial for both parties.

label.zh: 或许我们可以重新商议……

texts.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
texts.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We only learned of the practice when a large group of [space_slavers_species.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] was listed on an off-grid slave market.

label.zh: 如果他们想要我们的奴隶，那就得交税。
label.en: If they want our slaves, there's a tax!

texts.zh:
我们自[preftl_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：在这颗星球的偏远地区，有几个太空旅商，主要是走私贩，连同飞船一起消失了。通过谨慎的调查，我们发现他们被迫在矿井里工作，远离窥探的视线。

令人重视的是，[preftl_slavers_country.GetName]当局并不对此负责，这些事情是由当地的几个军阀和犯罪头子干的，此外所有被绑架的个体都违反了我们同[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]签订的协议。
texts.en:
We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their ships. A discreet investigation revealed that they were pressed into work in the mines, far from view.

It is important to note that this was not done by the  [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] authorities, but rather a few local warlords and criminals, and that all of the abducted individuals were in violation of the treaties we signed with the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural].

label.zh: 他们得到了他们应得的。
不可接受。保障他们的自由。

texts.zh:
[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]用行动证明了自己是天生的贸易商。我们自己的商人通过艰难的教训认识到当地人是如此有悟性、能说会道，当然他们对此不是很高兴。

另一方面，我们的数名经济学家相信[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的这些行为是可以效仿的。
texts.en:
The [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] have proven to be incredibly adept traders. Our own merchants are learning the hard way that the locals are both savvy and persuasive, and they are not happy about it.

On the other hand, several of our economists are convinced that the behavior of the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] could be learned from.

label.zh: 对[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName]施加以得到更有利的交易。

texts.zh: 自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
texts.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a marked decrease in the planet's standard of living.

texts.zh:
我们为[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]提供的金融刺激措施已经得到了丰厚的回报。他们的传统货币和经济机构在我们的支持下，终于稳定了下来。

也许更重要的是，公众对我们继续留在该星系中的支持度空前高涨。
texts.en:
The financial stimulus we provided to [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has paid off handsomely. With their traditional currencies and economic institutions bolstered by our support, conditions have finally stabilized.

Perhaps more importantly, public approval for our continued presence in the system has never been higher.

texts.zh:
我们对市场仁慈的信任得到了丰厚的回报。

摆脱了令人窒息的监管，[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]的金融机构已经稳定下来。那里的人们知道自己的经济前景一片大好，可以放心了。
texts.en:
Our trust in the benevolence of the market has paid off handsomely.

Freed from the imposition of stifling regulations, financial institutions on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] have stabilized. The people there can rest secure in the knowledge that their economic future is assured.

texts.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]市场自我纠正的信任变成了一场灾难，实在令人费解。事实上，星球上的状况前所未有的糟糕，人们吵着要政府加强对金融部门的监督。
texts.en: Inexplicably, our trust in the market to right itself on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has been a disaster. In fact, conditions on the planet have never been worse, and the people there are clamoring for increased government oversight in the financial sector.

texts.zh:
为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。

居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
texts.en:
To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being weaponized.

The inhabitants have arrived at the bold idea of reversing the functionality of a replication unit so rather than assembling pre-programmed matter, the device can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

texts.zh: 我们与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享了我们的物质复制技术。它们本来应该用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但它们愚蠢地把它武器化了。它们反转了复制单元的功能，开始制造一个可以用来在原子水平上拆解生命体的装置。
texts.en: We shared our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. They were supposed to use it to reduce resource scarcity. But they're foolishly trying to weaponize it. By crudely reversing the functionality of a replication unit, they have started building a device which can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

label.zh: 没收这项技术，不能相信它们会正确使用它。
label.en: Confiscate the tech. They cannot be trusted to use it correctly.

label.zh: 它们决定如何使用这项技术与我们无关。
label.en: What they choose to do with the tech is not our concern.

texts.zh:
我们的特工到达时，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]正好在完成它们的手持式原子分解器。我们的人明确告知，赠送物质复制装置不是为了让它们这样使用的。

不出所料，它们不愿意放弃这项技术。当地政府火冒三丈，将我们的没收称作侵略行为。
texts.en:
Our agents arrived just as the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] were finalizing their hand-held atomic disintegrator. They were told in no uncertain terms that this was not the intended use for the matter replication unit we gifted them.

As expected, they were reluctant to part with the technology. Tempers flared, and the local government has labeled the confiscation an aggressive act.

texts.zh:
通过对我们的物质复制技术进行逆向工程，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]成功地制造了一个手持式原子分解器，并利用它大肆摧毁[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]。

在启动进一步的贸易协议之前，我们最好记住它们的毁灭倾向。
texts.en:
By reverse engineering our matter replication technology, the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] have successfully built a hand-held atomic disintegrator, and are using it to wreak havoc upon [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName].

We'd do well to remember their destructive tendencies before initiating further trade deals.

texts.zh:
在[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]地表进行外交访问时，有一个孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]接近了我们。虽然[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]是一个格式化的物种，但这个子个体认为自己是一个个体，现在向我们请求庇护。

它看到我们后显然是受到了启发，希望融入我们的社会。当被询问时，它反复说自己无法融入蜂巢，并声称自己生来就一直拥有独立的意识。
texts.en:
While on a diplomatic visit to the surface of [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName], we were approached by a lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]. Although the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] are a gestalt species, the drone in question identifies as an individual, and is now requesting asylum.

Apparently inspired by what they have seen of us, they wish to integrate themselves into our society. When questioned, they repeatedly stated that they are unable to fit in within the hive, and claim to have possessed an individual consciousness all their life.

label.zh: 我们现在承担不起激怒蜂巢的后果。
label.en: We cannot afford to antagonize the hive.

texts.zh:
我们拒绝了孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]子个体的庇护请求。我们认为这对双方都是最好的。

没有得到我们的合作，[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]回到了同胞身边，乞求得到独立。

[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]向我们保证这只是一个反常子个体，它后来恢复了理智，并回到了集体中。这个所谓的个体不会再出现在我们面前。

与[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的外交继续进行。
texts.en:
We refused the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone's request for asylum. We believed it was in the best interest of both parties.

Without our cooperation, the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] returned to their people, to plead for their independence.

The [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] have assured us this was merely a deviant drone who has since seen sense, and has returned to the collective. We won't hear from the so-called individual again.

Diplomacy with [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] continues.

texts.zh: 起初，来自[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的孤独子个体被巨大的转变所吓倒。然而，在最初的文化冲击消退后，子个体现在正在适应作为个体的生活。也许具有讽刺意味的是，它已经变得像我们一样了。
texts.en: At first, the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone from [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] was overwhelmed by the scale of the transition. However, after the initial culture shock subsided, the drone is now adjusting to life as an individual. Perhaps ironically, they have become like us.

texts.zh:
从最近一次外交访问[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的[preftl_invasives_species.GetName]返回时，我们发现了一些不寻常的偷渡者。我们的穿梭机上出现了一群无翅的、蠕动的小型节肢动物。

它们移动速度很快，而且很小，我们的传感器无法探测到它们。由于它们繁殖十分迅速，控制它们的入侵变得越来越困难。

不幸的是，对[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的人们来说，这个物种是富足的象征。我们的应对方式可能会影响我们与[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]的关系。
texts.en:
When we returned from a recent diplomatic visit with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetName] of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName], we discovered we'd picked up some unusual stowaways. An infestation of small, wingless, wriggling arthropods had found their way aboard our shuttle.

They move fast, and are tiny enough that our sensors can't detect them. Given their rapid breeding, it has become increasingly difficult to contain the invasion.

Unfortunately, the species is a symbol of plenty to the people of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]. How we respond to this could affect our relations with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural].

label.zh: 通知该星球的统治者，我们要灭掉这些害虫。
label.en: Inform the planet's rulers that we will be exterminating the infestation.

label.zh: 悄悄处理掉这一情况，没必要侮辱它们。
label.en: Deal with this quietly. We need not insult them.

texts.zh:
我们把正在进行中的节肢动物入侵事件告知了[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的外交官。虽然我们的直率令它们吃惊，但它们最终还是感谢了我们的诚实。

它们为净化过程中的疏忽而道歉，并提供给我们一种经过试验和测试的人道驱虫剂，在[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]很受欢迎。
texts.en:
We confronted the [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] diplomats regarding the ongoing arthropod infestation. While taken aback by our directness, they ultimately appreciated our honesty.

They apologized for not being more thorough in their decontamination processes, and offered us a tried and tested cruelty free pest repellent, popular on [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
由于不想引起外交争端，我们试图悄悄地处理最近[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]害虫泛滥的问题。

由于这种生物繁殖快速，并且它们喜好吃非有机物质，这项工作并不轻松。

当我们的外交官穿着被虫蛀得破烂不堪的衣服出现在一个会议上时，[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]一眼就知道发生了什么。

它们似乎为这种生物感到尴尬，于是给我们提供了一种人道的驱虫剂。
texts.en:
Not wishing to cause a diplomatic issue, we attempted to quietly deal with the recent infestation of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] pests.

This has not been a simple task given the rapid breeding of the creatures, and their penchant for eating through non-organic materials.

When our diplomats turned up to a conference in tattered, bug-eaten attire, the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural] knew exactly what had happened.

Seemingly embarrassed about introducing the creatures, they provided us with a cruelty-free pest repellent.

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

他们不知道民主带给了我们什么样的好处，也不知道自由的真正味道。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

They know nothing of the benefits that democracy can bring, or the true taste of freedom.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

他们必须了解是什么让我们雄伟和强大的国度如此的雄伟强大。他们尚未品尝过帝国主义的滋味。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

They must learn what makes our great and powerful domain so great and powerful. They have yet to experience the taste of empire.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

我们应该将他们从这种愚行中解放出来。独裁政权的滋味将让他们重新放飞自我。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

We ought to liberate them from such folly. The taste of dictatorship shall set them free.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。

将权力集中在精心挑选的一小部分人手中是统治的唯一方法。他们是如何意识不到这一点的，这真是一个谜。
texts.en:
The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

Concentrating powers among a select few is the only way to rule. How they have not come to realize this on their own is a true mystery.

label.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。

texts.zh:
在将我们的政治哲学传授给他们之后，[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]沿袭我们的方式，开始了政体改革。

这些计划正在全球范围内推广，迎来[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]的一个新时代。为了纪念这一政治意义上翻天覆地的巨大变革，新的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]政府举行了一场向我们致敬的游行。
texts.en:
After instructing them in our political philosophy, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] have taken steps towards reforming their government along the lines of our own.

These initiatives are taking place on a planetary scale, ringing in a new era for the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]. To mark this dramatic political overhaul, the new [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] government held a parade in our honor.

texts.zh:
在学习了我们如何运用权力之后，[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]选择维持[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的现状，认为这才是最好的进步方式。

他们已经宣誓要守住自己的本心，绝不因外部势力的影响而动摇。

外交仍然在继续进行，但毫无疑问，他们不像之前那么信任我们了。
texts.en:
Having learned of our approach to power, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] maintain that status quo on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] remains the best way forward.

They have vowed to stand their ground, and not be swayed by external forces.

Diplomacy continues, but there can be no doubt they trust us less.

texts.zh:
相较于向对方施加压力，我们更乐于冷静地向[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]解释我们的政体权力制度背后的相关理论。

他们深深地折服于我们就不同形式政府模式所阐述的观点，对于我们不曾尝试强迫他们服从这一点，他们表示了感激。

双方各自的外交官已经缔结了长期的联系纽带，一同庆祝一场共享的宴会。基于互惠的条款，外交持续推进。
texts.en:
Rather than applying any pressure outright, we calmly explained the theory behind our governing authority to the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName].

They were intrigued by the insights we provided into alternative styles of government, and were vocal in their appreciation that we made no attempt to force them into compliance.

Our respective diplomats have formed lasting ties, celebrating together over a shared banquet. Diplomacy continues on good terms.

label.zh: 尊重是一条双向的超空间航道。
label.en: Respect is a two way hyperlane.

texts.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName]担心穴居人可能会发动一场入侵。这样的担忧是毫无根据的，但是提供额外的部队能够帮助我们赢取他们的信任。
texts.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName] are worried about a possible subterranean invasion. It's a baseless fear, but providing additional troops will help us gain their trust.
